401920808.headline: SE Louisiana vs. Texas A&M prediction: model has Texas A&M by 29
paragraphs: SE Louisiana (1-2) visits Texas A&M at Reed Arena in College Station Monday at 8:30 PM ET on SECN+.

Our model makes Texas A&M a 28.9-point favorite, projecting a 92-63 final, and gives Texas A&M a 99% chance to win. The betting market has Texas A&M favored by 33.5 with a total of 159.5. The model leans SE Louisiana +33.5 and Under 159.5.
Players to watch: Quincy Allen of SE Louisiana, 8.3 points a game; Yanis Ndjonga of SE Louisiana, 7.3 points a game; Garrett Shoemaker of SE Louisiana, 4.7 points a game.
SE Louisiana traveled about 622 miles to College Station.
